categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the optical panel and touch panel business, including the sale of touch glass, optical coated glass, and thinned and strengthened glass. It also engages in the manufacturing and sales of touch panel modules and glass substrates. Additionally, the company has diversified into renewable energy, focusing on solar power plant development and operation, and has recently entered the drone industry with high-mobility folding fixed-wing drones. It also develops electric assisted bicycles as part of its new business lines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced glass processing technologies including cutting, polishing, strengthening, thinning, and optical coating. It employs laser engraving and inkjet printing processes for automation and precision. In renewable energy, it develops solar power plants with innovative installation methods such as screwless curved roof mounting. For drones, it focuses on hardware design, flight control systems, and edge computing for autonomous flight and target locking. The company also emphasizes R&D in touch panel integration with sensors and modular electric bicycle components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers and suppliers in the TFT-LCD panel industry, covering sectors such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, automotive displays, commercial signage, and medical and gaming touch panels. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales to Asian markets, especially China. The renewable energy segment targets solar power plant owners and operators, including overseas markets in Southeast Asia. The drone products are aimed at commercial, disaster relief, and surveillance applications, focusing on the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan, with sales and operations primarily in Taiwan and Asia, especially China and Southeast Asia. It has established overseas sales and after-sales service systems and cooperates with local agents in various regions. The renewable energy projects include domestic solar power plants and overseas projects in Southeast Asia. The drone business targets the Asia-Pacific market, including Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the upstream segment of the touch panel industry, focusing on glass substrate processing and touch panel module manufacturing. It acts as an agent and manufacturer for TFT-LCD panels and related components. In renewable energy, it is involved in the development, construction, and operation of solar power plants, positioning itself as a project developer and operator. In the drone sector, it is engaged in product development and manufacturing, moving towards integrated system solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding high-value-added and niche products such as large-size projected capacitive touch panels and specialized panels for medical and gaming applications. The company aims to stabilize and grow its customer base by shortening delivery times and enhancing product development in TDM and TPM modules. It is investing in renewable energy, particularly solar power plants, to secure long-term stable revenue. The drone business is a key R&D focus, with efforts on autonomous flight, AI mission systems, and edge computing. The company also plans to develop electric assisted bicycles with improved quality and modular systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of optical panels, touch panels, and related modules. The company also earns income from renewable energy operations, including solar power plant electricity sales. Additionally, it plans to generate revenue from drone product sales and electric assisted bicycle sales and services. The company engages in OEM and OBM sales models and has expanded physical and virtual sales channels for its own brand products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the highly competitive TFT-LCD and touch panel market, maintaining stable sales channels and customer relationships through quality, pricing, and delivery reliability. It leverages its professional marketing team and technical expertise to differentiate products. In renewable energy, it competes by acquiring and operating solar power plants with experienced teams. The drone market is emerging, with the company positioning itself as a fast-developing player with advanced autonomous flight capabilities. The company faces challenges from market price fluctuations and competition but aims to enhance competitiveness through innovation and vertical integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$308 million, a decrease from the previous year due to the disposal of a major subsidiary. It experienced a net loss attributable to the parent company of about NT$133 million, reflecting increased expenses from new business development and impairment losses. The company’s total assets increased significantly due to capital increases and solar power plant acquisitions, reaching over NT$1.27 billion. Despite current losses, the company is investing heavily in renewable energy and new product development, aiming for long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized touch panel products with strong customer recognition for quality and delivery. It differentiates through innovative product lines such as large-size capacitive touch panels and specialized panels for medical and gaming applications. In renewable energy, it offers integrated development and operation capabilities, reducing costs and improving returns. The drone products feature advanced autonomous flight, AI mission systems, and modular designs for commercial and emergency applications. The company also leverages its extensive industry experience and strong customer relationships to provide value-added services and reduce customer transaction costs.
